subject.title: fix(googlechat): fall back to text link when remote media upload fails with 403

question: Should maintainers refresh and use this PR as the canonical Google Chat media-upload 403 fallback, or pause it in favor of another open candidate?
rationale: The fix is useful, but the branch is conflicting and overlaps with other open PRs for the same delivery bug, so automation cannot safely choose the landing branch or accept the merge-risk boundary.

options.title: Refresh This Candidate

options.title: Pick Another Canonical PR

options.title: Defer The Fallback
